one_liner: Recall helps teams choose AI services by comparing workload costs, checking documented conditions, and showing what still needs setup before they commit.
description: Recall helps teams choose AI services before committing money or customer data. Compare 17 plans from 13 providers across transcription, speech generation and text generation; export a two-provider brief. No wallet or supplier outreach is needed to compare or capture evidence. Optional GenLayer assessments for the audio categories bind findings and source passages to a saved snapshot. Text generation supports comparison and evidence capture only. Historical Speechmatics v3 and AssemblyAI v4 runs show supported commitments versus required setup; consensus does not guarantee correctness. Prices are qualified catalog estimates, not model quotes. A separate historical Studio experiment shows a changed-terms cancellation and 0.040 test-GEN replacement transfer. Provider checkout is not integrated. Account settings, service quality and compliance are not verified. Records are browser-local; continuous monitoring and a purchasing-agent API are future work.

how_to.heading: Compare without a wallet
how_to.instruction: Open /compare. Enter 100 audio hours per month and a $50 budget, keep No model training selected and speaker labels off, then choose Compare options. Select Speechmatics and AssemblyAI in the side-by-side view. Read the estimate qualifiers; the lowest base rate is not necessarily the cheapest eligible configuration.

how_to.heading: Inspect evidence and saved findings
how_to.instruction: Use Open saved review when a matching result exists in this browser. Otherwise choose Review evidence, Review this provider and Capture evidence to save public source text without a Studio transaction. Capture is not an assessment. Saved review IDs are browser-local, not portable result links.

how_to.heading: Understand required setup
how_to.instruction: The verified AssemblyAI v4 example supports API access, pre-recorded audio, English and single-channel audio; No model training Requires setup. Choose Review required setup to inspect the documented opt-out and confirmation requirements. Recall has not enabled them for your account; confirm the resulting price separately.

how_to.heading: Leave with a decision brief
how_to.instruction: Use Compare alternatives or Back to your comparison, then Export comparison. Open the downloaded HTML report: it includes the applied requirements, qualified costs, sources and any matching saved findings. Save option keeps a local shortlist. No provider order or payment is made.

how_to.heading: Optional new GenLayer assessment
how_to.instruction: For a genuinely new audio-category review, choose Review with GenLayer, review the evidence-sharing notice, Studio Next (61997) network and explicit test-GEN protocol fee deposit, then approve separately in your wallet. Provider payment is zero; protocol fees are not zero. Text assessment is still under validation. Do not resubmit completed or unresolved reviews for the demo. Receipt verification binds the result to the request; it does not prove assessment accuracy.

how_to.heading: Inspect the separate payment experiment
how_to.instruction: Open /proof without a wallet. Compare the canceled original with its separately reviewed replacement, then inspect the verified 0.040 test-GEN recipient transfer. This historical run uses fictional terms; it is not a payment integration for the public provider catalog.

expected_outcome: A team leaves with a two-provider decision brief showing its requirements, qualified costs, source dates and matching saved findings. Verified examples distinguish Speechmatics' supported commitments from AssemblyAI's required training opt-out setup. Unknown prices and account settings stay unresolved. The separate /proof archive demonstrates a historical test-GEN transfer, not provider checkout. No real provider purchase is made.
